searchText: Hello! I hope this is the right channel to report such an issue. Grandine caches (without an upper bound) invalid signed envelopes (don't need to be builder) with slot = u64::MAX, so it is possible to DoS a Grandine node via gossip. One vector is millions of zero-byte txs in the signed envelope. Q: with ePBS, what is the publishing strategy for blobs? Publish at the same time as the payload or earlier/later? I don't know what builders will do but the honest strategy is to publish as soon as you see the block including your bid not only honest, but probably incentivized to publish as soon as you see your bid in the block to get DA votes from ptc. Hi there, I was looking at the current Gloas specs. Are `PAYLOAD_DUE_BPS` and `PAYLOAD_ATTESTATION_DUE_BPS` at 6s and 9s respectively what is currently expected to ship? Put differently, is the free option going to remain in the protocol without a protocol-level mitigation? Yes as of now, I believe the strongest mitigation we have for the free option problem is a first-offense global ban of any relay and all builders participating in that relay. Other than that we have nothing better than penalties but those are not in protocol as of now.
